ctx.x: For sure. A while ago you mentioned Jelly Roll Morton. Did you ever meet him?

Yes. I knew Jelly Roll Morton. He used to hang around a place in New York City on 132nd and Second Avenue called Bert Hall's Rhythm Club where all the musicians hung out, and they had jam sessions there. They had a piano as you walk in, you know, and guys like the great Fats Waller and J.P. Johnson, and they used to jam. Willie Smith and all these guys, and Jelly Roll Morton used to stand around and he'd crack his jaw to these guys, and he'd say, 'You might play more piano than me, but I write more tunes,' he…
